categories.label: Large parks

agripv.label: AgriPV agricultural screening queue
agripv.interpretation: A geographically balanced queue of official open-field agricultural parcels outside the current AGRO-plan centroids. Every parcel remains an unverified agricultural area until field activity and the farmer relationship are confirmed; this is not a technical-potential, capacity, permit or buildability conclusion.

industrial.label: Industrial rooftop potential
industrial.sourceGeometry: Official local-authority boundaries joined to GovMap industrial-rooftop aggregates
industrial.interpretation: Reuse the official high-resolution built-area analysis without rebuilding it. Published geometry is authority-level context, not a roof footprint.
industrial.handoff: Inspect the authority aggregate here; use GovMap for its underlying rooftop analysis.

public.label: Public-space solar covering potential
public.interpretation: Official GovMap public-space polygons and estimates are mirrored without recalculation, with source attribution and usage restriction preserved.
public.handoff: Inspect official polygons here or open the source GovMap layer.
